scientific_integrity: All-size claims have mathematical proofs; finite counts have independently implemented exhaustive checks. Known noncrossing-tree enumerator is credited, not presented as novel.
scientific_limitations: Full noncrossing partitions on convex cyclic labels only; no all-size formula for intermediate support counts. Finite censuses verified through eight vertices. Priority comparison limited to accessible literature and indexed research records; independent validation not performed.
title: Geometric deletion criterion for shattering by noncrossing partitions
